issue.title: Type-check extensionless tools scripts in the normal lint gate
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-i8.10.4 (originally sase-i8.2). Reproduced on integrated master 1417de7db: pyproject.toml [tool.mypy].files is only ['src']; explicit '.venv/bin/mypy tools/validate_sase_core_rs' finds union-attr errors at lines 561, 564, and 567, while '.venv/bin/mypy tools' reports no .py[i] files because the tools are extensionless executables. Scope: design and implement reliable normal-gate mypy coverage for supported extensionless tools scripts, remediate the surfaced typing errors, and add a regression proving tool-script defects cannot remain invisible.
